nodes.label: Communication and decision explanations
nodes.definition: Updates, transparency, information sharing or reasons for decisions

nodes.label: Employee voice and follow-through
nodes.definition: Listening to suggestions, raising concerns, being heard, issue response or action on feedback

nodes.label: Recognition and performance feedback
nodes.definition: Appreciation, recognition, awards or constructive performance feedback

nodes.label: Career growth and learning
nodes.definition: Explicit training, skill/knowledge learning, employee growth, promotions, career paths or role development; unspecified opportunities alone are insufficient

nodes.label: Fair treatment and decision consistency
nodes.definition: Bias, equal treatment/opportunities, merit criteria or consistent application of decisions

nodes.label: Workload, boundaries and flexibility
nodes.definition: Work allocation/capacity, backup, time boundaries, shifts, flexibility or wellbeing

nodes.label: Teamwork and cross-team coordination
nodes.definition: Valued team/colleague relationships, helping colleagues, collaboration, handovers or coordination between teams/branches

nodes.label: Support and respectful treatment
nodes.definition: Manager, senior or organisational support, practical guidance, approachability, dignity or respectful feedback; keep unspecified support broad

nodes.label: Pay, incentives and benefits
nodes.definition: Salary, monetary incentives, insurance, allowances, food or welfare benefits

nodes.label: Facilities, tools and staffing
nodes.definition: Workplace hygiene, equipment, IT systems, resources, office access or headcount

nodes.label: Role clarity and work processes
nodes.definition: Responsibilities, hierarchy, SOPs, escalation routes, ownership, goals or workflow simplification

nodes.label: Trust, integrity and autonomy
nodes.definition: Trust in people, empowerment, ethical conduct, honesty, reliability or commitments

nodes.label: Activities and social connection
nodes.definition: Outings, celebrations, gatherings, sports or social activities
